title: Papillote Style Haricot Beans with Pillowy Russian Flatbread
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring pillowy flatbread and tender, flavorful haricot beans. This recipe showcases the simplicity of French-inspired papillote cooking.

ingredients.name: Russian flatbread dough
ingredients.notes: You can also use store-bought dough or substitute with a similar flatbread

ingredients.name: Pillowy dough
ingredients.notes: Similar to Russian flatbread dough, store-bought or homemade

instructions: 2. Prepare flatbread dough according to package instructions or recipe.
3. Roll out each dough into thin circles, about 6-8 inches in diameter.
4. Brush flatbreads with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and optional garlic or herbs.
5. In a separate pan, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add haricot beans and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
6. Spoon cooked haricot beans onto one half of each flatbread circle.
7. Fold the other half of the flatbread over the beans to form a half-moon shape. Press edges to seal.
8. Place papillotes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, seam-side down.
9. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until flatbreads are golden and crispy.
10. Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
